architecture: EfficientNet-B2 + EfficientNet-B0 + MobileNetV2 ensemble (6 TorchScript models, weighted probability averaging)

ensemble.aggregation: softmax probabilities averaged across members per crop, then averaged over the five crops — the same order backend/scripts/evaluate.py uses for a single model, applied to the averaged probabilities; decision gates unchanged
ensemble.fallback: ensemble incomplete or corrupt -> exp-3 single model (fabric_v2_parts) -> bundled v1 model; a partial parts landing never activates the ensemble
ensemble.weights: weighted — exp15 0.2, exp14 0.32, exp12 0.16, exp3/exp6/exp2 0.8×2/15 each (ensemble probe v9 combo 'e': exp15 ×0.2 + combo f ×0.8) — per-member numeric weights below are the serving config

evaluation.exclusions: non_fabric has no held-out images: its 5 val + 5 test images were byte-identical copies of train images and are denylisted in data/quarantine_leaked/non_fabric/LEAKED_FILES.txt (excluded by train.py and evaluate.py). Its metrics are null (unmeasured), not zero.
evaluation.method: five-crop inference identical to backend/scripts/evaluate.py (EXIF transpose, leaked-file denylist, top-1 with no decision-gate filtering for accuracy), computed by the offline ensemble probe from per-crop softmax caches; all single-model control values (including exp15's 0.8123 / 0.6706 / 0.6238, exp14's 0.8267 / 0.6589 / 0.6277 and exp12's 0.8051 / 0.6628 / 0.6335) reproduced the previously recorded numbers exactly before any ensemble figure was taken
evaluation.provenance: Members: exp15 chunk1_final (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp15-b2-distill-enriched — a single EfficientNet-B2 distilled from the combo-f ensemble, stage A enriched with the S1 staged admixture of 800 verified garment photos; highest real-photo score of any single model), exp14 stage1_best (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp14-b2-distill — a single EfficientNet-B2 distilled from the combo-b ensemble), exp12 stage-1 distilled student (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp12-distill — a single EfficientNet-B0 distilled from the combo-e teachers), exp3 chunk2_best (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp3-cleanheavy, previously live as the single model), exp6 chunk1_final (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp6-v5-ladder), exp2 stage B final (Kaggle laundry-v4-exp2-twostage). Combo 'e' of ensemble probe v9: exp15 x0.2 + combo f x0.8. It beat the previous ensemble (combo f) on all three sets (clean 0.8484 vs 0.8448, real-photo 0.6803 vs 0.6745, dim 0.6511 vs 0.6472). Shipped 2026-11-08 on the owner's explicit approval. No val-split ensemble figure is claimed: the probe cached test/real-photo probabilities only, so val fields are omitted rather than estimated.

realphoto_test.note: Held-out whole-garment product photos (TextileNet), never trained on. The exp-3 single model scores 0.5867 on this set and the previous ensemble (combo f) 0.6745; this ensemble scores 0.6803.

realphoto_test_dim.note: Dimmed copies of the realphoto_test images. The exp-3 single model scores 0.5419 on this set and the previous ensemble (combo f) 0.6472; this ensemble scores 0.6511.

evaluation.script: ensemble probe v9 over backend/scripts/evaluate.py semantics --data data/test (gate set, 277 images after denylist), realphoto_test, realphoto_test_dim
